title: Implement missing PWA and Android acceptance tooling
steps: Inspect existing Godot Web, PWA and Capacitor packaging scripts and identify locally automatable gaps.
Implement only tooling or validation needed for artifact integrity, offline launch, update behavior, asset sync or reproducible Android packaging.
Add tests for the new tooling and preserve Godot as the sole client/rendering runtime.
Keep physical-device install, browser touch behavior and signed-release acceptance explicitly human/device gates.
acceptance: All newly automatable delivery checks are implemented and passing; unsupported device/provider checks remain explicit and unclaimed.
